entities.name: Ondu Skyclave
entities.description: One of seven floating fortresses built by the ancient kor empire on Zendikar; it fell over six thousand years ago and was reawakened in the Rise of the Skyclaves.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire that built the Skyclaves and fell in civil war.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: Capital of the Kor Empire, destroyed when the Ondu Skyclave turned on it.

entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: Isle where the Skyclave fell and now floats above.

entities.name: Rise of the Skyclaves
entities.description: Event in 4561 AR in which the Skyclaves were reactivated.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Leader of an adventuring party that activated the Emeria skyclave's defenses.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Vampire scholar who joins an expedition and petrifies Grakmaw.

entities.name: Tarsa
entities.description: Captain of the expedition who offers Anowon a place among them.

entities.name: Nadino
entities.description: Fiery adventurer who threatens Anowon, then helps him petrify Grakmaw.

entities.name: Eret
entities.description: Skeptical elven cleric of the expedition.

entities.name: Grakmaw
entities.description: Mutated hydra likely born from ancient kor experimentation, the party's target.

entities.name: Expeditionary Houses
entities.description: Groups drawn to explore the Skyclave's ruins.

events.summary: During the civil war the Ondu Skyclave turns against Makindi, destroying it, and falls onto Jwar Isle.
events.quote: the Ondu Skyclave turned against the empire's capital at Makindi

events.summary: The Skyclave's fragments levitate again after Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses.
events.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

events.summary: Anowon joins Tarsa, Nadino and Eret on an expedition to the Skyclave.
events.quote: the vampire scholar Anowon join a reluctant band of adventurers

events.summary: Grakmaw attacks the party in the ruins and proves nearly impossible to kill.
events.quote: its regenerative heads made it nearly impossible to kill

events.summary: Anowon and Nadino use a petrification potion to turn Grakmaw to stone; Tarsa offers Anowon a place among them.
events.quote: used it to turn Grakmaw to stone mid-battle, ending the threat

relations.quote: used it to turn Grakmaw to stone mid-battle, ending the threat

relations.note: Offered him a place among them.
relations.quote: Tarsa, moved by the vampire's integrity, offered him a place among them going forward.
constructed by the ancient kor empire on the plane of Zendikar
